author: StarTalk
description:
Would aliens use the same periodic table as us? Neil deGrasse Tyson and comic co-host Negin Farsad sit down with Kate Biberdorf, aka Kate the Chemist, to tackle fan questions about the chemistry of life, diamonds, how fire works, and spontaneous combustion.

Is there such a thing as a liquid diamond and could you swim in a pool of it? Kate walks through the phase chemistry of carbon, why melting a diamond means it's no longer a diamond, and what the difference actually is between a crystal and a liquid crystal. Do crystals actually influence energy? We discuss crystal shops, the science behind why crystals are the lowest energy state of their atoms, and why "diamonds are forever" is really just a statement about molecular stability.

Could life on other planets be built from completely different chemistry? Kate and Neil explore silicon as a carbon alternative, the case for methane as a solvent on Titan, amino acids found on asteroids, and the biggest open question in astrobiology: is
title: Is Chemistry the Same Throughout the Universe? With Kate the Chemist
